replication.target_description: Supplied page 4 and broad description identify multiple LCA and group-comparison tests; no unique target test or outcome distinguishes the two assigned rows.

reported_success.quote: Results replicated the four patterns of negative emotional eating

notes: Both assigned rows have identical broad descriptions and p. 4 locators. Page 4 includes class-solution fit comparisons, sex differences, typical and muscularity-oriented eating disorder symptomatology and other outcomes. Selecting one statistic would require an unsupplied test/outcome locator. Replication sample is general Chinese adults aged 18–75, not exclusively the young adults aged 17–24 in the neutral original-study description.
